# Product Requirements Document

## RU RAGA Communication App

**Version:** 1.0 (Draft) **Date:** July 9, 2026 **Team size:** 15–30 dancers \+ captains

---

## 1\. Problem Statement

The team currently coordinates via a Telegram channel. While Telegram works well for casual, real-time chats, it fails at three specific jobs:

1. **Important updates get buried** in the scroll of conversation, so dancers miss announcements or have to scroll back to find them.  
2. **RSVP coordination is manual and noisy** — dancers text captains individually to confirm or decline practice attendance, overwhelming captains with one-off conversations instead of a clear headcount.  
3. **Practice videos??**

## 2\. Goal

Build an app that sits alongside Telegram (not replacing it) and becomes the team's single source of truth for:

- What's happening (roundup of official updates)  
- Who's coming to practice (structured RSVP)  
- What happened last practice (video archive)

Telegram remains the real-time chat layer, but app acts as a centralized hub for team communication.

## 3\. Users & Roles

| Role | Permissions |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Captains** | Create/manage practice events, view RSVP summaries, upload and organize videos, (optionally) tag Telegram messages for the roundup |
| **Dancers** | View roundup dashboard, RSVP yes/no with reason, watch practice videos — read-only otherwise |

This keeps the app low-noise for dancers by design — no in-app messaging system to maintain in parallel with Telegram.

## 4\. Core Features (MVP — all three at equal priority)

### 4.1 Daily Roundup Dashboard

- **Source:** Pulled automatically from the team's Telegram channel via the Telegram Bot API (bot added as a channel member/admin).  
- Displays a clean, chronological feed of official updates — no need for captains to double-post.  
- **Filtering:** Only messages from captains (or messages tagged, e.g. `#update`) are pulled in, to avoid re-introducing the noise problem.  
- **Open question:** raw text mirror vs. lightly reformatted/categorized (e.g., Announcements / Costume & Logistics / Choreo Notes).  
- **Open question:** whether media (images/video) posted in Telegram surfaces here too, or stays exclusive to the Video Library.

### 4.2 Practice Planner \+ RSVP

- Calendar/list view of upcoming practices: date, time, location, and plan/focus for that session.  
- Dancers tap **Yes** or **No**; a **No** requires (or optionally allows) a short reason.  
- Captains see an aggregated headcount at a glance (e.g., "18 yes / 3 no / 4 no response") instead of individual texts.  
  1. RVSP only available for captains  
- **Nice-to-have (post-MVP):** automated reminder nudge for non-responders 24 hours before practice.  
  1. nice to have: mini reminders about practices like on AV days: ex) boys wear black, girls wear white.

### 4.3 Video Library

- Practice videos organized by date and/or by song/set. \- can be grouped in folders  
- Instead of uploading video into app (which might be more complicated), captains \+ dancers can upload YT video links but the app has specified labels so that its easier to filter \- which is a mechanism YT playlist isnt good at  
- NICE TO HAVE: commenting on videos. for example) being able to comment on critiques or at certain points of songs on the app instead of having to text the person individually. also opens up the floor for more people to give their input on an all out 

## 5\. Technical Approach

- **Roundup ingestion:** Telegram Bot API integration. Bot must be added as a member/admin of the channel or private group to read messages. Sender-based filtering (and/or hashtag filtering) applied before displaying in-app.  
- **RSVP & practice planning:** native in-app feature (not sourced from Telegram — structured event data doesn't map to chat text).  
- **Video storage:** in-app upload and library, organized by metadata (date, set/song).

## 6\. Open Questions to Resolve Before Build

1. Public Telegram channel or private group? (Affects bot setup steps.)  
2. Should RSVP reason be required or optional on a "No"?  
3. Are RSVP reasons visible to the full team or captains only?  
4. Do Telegram media posts (images/video) need to also surface in the roundup, or stay exclusive to the Video Library?  
5. In-app video recording, or upload-only?  
6. Timestamped video comments, or clean playback only?  
7. Are push notifications worth building for v1, or likely to get muted like Telegram alerts?

## 7\. Success Metrics (suggested)

- % reduction in confusion over practice times and commitments (like with finance, social, props, etc)  
- Captains & production chairs reported time saved per week on logistics coordination  
- Weekly active usage of the Video Library

## 8\. Future Considerations (post-MVP)

- Push notification system for new roundup posts or practice changes  
- Automated RSVP reminders  
- Attendance history/analytics per dancer  
- When AV starts, dancer’s forms can be uploaded in a centralized place
